name: @m3au/purr
description: Key management that integrates 1Password, SSH, and GPG. Securely loads and unloads keys, configures Git signing, and manages GitHub credentials - all with a simple purr command.

scripts.coverage: rm -rf coverage && kcov --include-pattern=.sh --exclude-pattern=.spec. --include-path=lib coverage 'lib/purr' 'lib/modules/**/*.sh' 'scripts/*.sh' && open coverage/index.html
